rules.sentence: The clinical recognition of acute colonic diverticulitis (ACD) can be challenging because left lower quadrant pain, leukocytosis, and fever are common symptoms.

Radiology is crucial in differentiating diverticulitis from other diseases with similar findings and guiding treatment decisions, including conservative management, percutaneous drainage, and surgical intervention.
